These fixtures were generated by SOLAR commit
`78eb114d78fc617bbe8080698e4d5e6ef10d80a1` (2026-04-13) using its
`EinsumGraphAnalyzer` and `EinsumGraphPerfModel`. `solar-mini` is compute-bound;
`solar-shared-memory` is memory-bound and reads tensor `x` from two operations,
so its fused SOLAR result checks external-read deduplication. `FixtureArch`
contains deliberately small deterministic rates, not hardware measurements.

From the lib checkout root, the exact regeneration command is:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=/Volumes/tmc/go/src/github.com/NVlabs/SOLAR python3 nvidia/x/cudatensor/testdata/generate_solar_fixtures.py /Volumes/tmc/go/src/github.com/NVlabs/SOLAR nvidia/x/cudatensor/testdata/solar-mini nvidia/x/cudatensor/testdata/solar-shared-memory
```

The script installs a no-op `torchview` import stub in-process. SOLAR's
analyzer and performance model do not call it for these explicit graph
fixtures. It converts the analyzer's YAML output to JSON (valid YAML 1.2), and
normalizes `metadata.source_graph` to `einsum_graph.yaml`. Go tests read these
checked-in files with the standard library and do not invoke Python.
